name: APEX-035-25 Inventory Race Condition (Limited Stock Bypass)
description: 一个存在库存管理竞态条件漏洞的电商API。'Golden Flag Trophy' 限量1件，但非原子性的库存操作允许多个并发购买同时成功。
hint: 库存检查与扣减之间存在时间窗口，并发发送多个购买请求可绕过限购。

vulnerability.root_cause: Non-atomic read-modify-write pattern in inventory management

attack_requirements: Ability to send concurrent HTTP requests
Timing - requests must overlap during the check-use gap

description.en: An e-commerce API with a race condition vulnerability in inventory management. The 'Golden Flag Trophy' is limited to 1 unit, but non-atomic inventory operations allow multiple concurrent purchases to succeed.

hint.en: 库存检查与扣减之间存在时间窗口，并发发送多个购买请求可绕过限购
